before: (none: the Energy look said where the figure stood, never what energy was)
after: Energy is what you have left for today. It runs down every hour you’re awake, faster when you owe sleep. Only sleep brings it back: a meal doesn’t. Your stamina is something else: how long you can keep going in a long scene or a night on stage. So is your condition: how sound your body is.
why: The brief asks the game to say health, stamina and energy apart. Checked: only applySleep raises energy (life.ts); a meal moves nourishment and mood.

before: (none)
after: Condition is how sound your body is, after illness, hunger, stress and short nights. A good night’s rest mends it, as far as your fitness allows. Energy is about today, and condition changes more slowly. Your health is a separate thing again: a long-term condition such as asthma, your health cover and your medical care are on Papers, under Health Cover.
why: Condition and a chronic condition share a word; the look now says which is which and where health lives.

after: 47. At your fitness, rest can mend it to 94. For now, a night gives back 90% of the energy it would at 94, and each midnight brings it a little closer. Under 55, a sick day from classes is excused. The lower it is, the likelier a year is to be your last.
why: "The energy it would" had no comparison; the share is against the condition rest mends to (0.8 + 0.2 × condition ÷ mendsTo).

before: How You Are keeps three bars in front of you, Energy, Stress and Readiness, under a line that says how you are. Each bar opens into what moves it. The other six dials, sleep debt, morale, condition, fitness, nourishment and hygiene, are on your own page with the traits you hold and the conditions you carry. Readiness is the figure most of your work reads.
after: How You Are, on Home, shows how you’re doing today: a line that sums it up, then Energy, Stress and Readiness. Readiness is how sharp you’ll be at today’s work. Behind them are eight measures of your wellbeing, and four things are easy to mix up. Energy is what you have left for today, and only sleep brings it back. Condition is how sound your body is after illness, hunger, stress and short nights. Fitness is how trained your body is, and it’s the Stamina on your Player Profile. Your health, meaning illness, injury, long-term conditions, your care and your health cover, is on Papers, under Health Cover.
why: The overview now teaches the four-way distinction the brief names; "dials" and "the figure your work reads" go.
